_comment: Recorded baseline for the AgentFuse eval. CI asserts we never fall below these. A floor, not an achievement. The generated suite (536 scenarios) is the statistically meaningful one; the 16 hand-written cases are named regression cases. Recovery metrics added 2026-08-12 - before that, AgentFuse's central claim ('it steers the agent back') was completely unmeasured.
config_note: drift_threshold default lowered 0.45 -> 0.20 on 2026-08-12 based on the threshold sweep: F1 66.0->73.3, FPR 39.0->10.8, premature trips 54->0, at a cost of 6.4 points of recall. | LoopDetector rewritten 2026-08-12 to require an identical RESULT, not just an identical call: FPR 11.8%->4.9%, precision 82.5%->92.0%, F1 72.2%->75.7%, recall unchanged. Call-only fallback at 2x threshold still catches loops whose output varies cosmetically. | NoProgressDetector rewritten 2026-08-12: the old one incremented its stall counter ONLY on a repeated state hash, but a genuine stall emits no state updates at all, so the trip condition was unreachable - it required evidence of state changes to detect their absence. Now counts weighted actions since the last genuine advance. recall 64.3->89.2, F1 75.7->91.5, progress family 0%->100%, FPR unchanged at 4.9%. | LoopDetector args normalised (case/whitespace/punctuation) 2026-08-12: loop recall 65.5->100 on cosmetic variants, attribution restored 86.9->99.1. Then a REWORDED-args generator was added to keep the benchmark honest, which correctly pulled loop recall back to 89.5% and overall to 87.9%.

known_weak_families.loop: 89.5% - REWORDED arguments (same request, genuinely different wording) are still missed. Surface normalisation cannot collapse differing tokens; this needs semantic comparison. A new generator was added specifically so the benchmark does not flatter the normalisation fix.
known_weak_families.drift: 73% - gradual drift still overlaps the legitimate-paraphrase band lexically.
known_weak_families.attribution: 89% - some reworded loops are caught by PROGRESS as a backstop rather than by LOOP, so the steering advice is blunter than ideal.

significance.note: F1 must significantly exceed a rate-matched random control (p < 0.05).

economics_note: 'tokens saved' is WASTE AVOIDED (what the doomed run would have burned after the halt), not net benefit including completing the task. The recovered path's own cost is charged to tokens_spent. Treat ROI as an upper bound on the real economic case.
